title: PICC line placement
what: A long, thin tube is placed through a vein in your arm. Its tip reaches a large vein near the heart. It can stay in for weeks or months.
why: For long treatment through a vein: chemotherapy, antibiotics, feeding, or frequent blood tests.
duration: placement usually takes 30 to 60 minutes; the line stays as long as treatment needs
tell_doctor: Allergy to local anesthetic, antiseptics or adhesive tape
Surgery on the chest or armpit, or lymph nodes removed on one side
Past blood clots in the arm veins
Kidney disease: sometimes it affects which arm is chosen

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually you can eat as normal. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop them on your own. The doctor will tell you about blood thinners.

prepare.title: Clothing
prepare.text: A wide sleeve or a shirt with buttons.

steps: You lie down and your arm is moved out to the side
The vein is found with ultrasound
The skin is cleaned and numbed with an injection
The doctor or nurse inserts the tube into the vein and moves it toward the heart
The tip position is checked with an ECG or X-ray
The line is secured to the skin and covered with a clear dressing
feel: Pressure in the arm during insertion, usually not painful
The arm may ache a little for a couple of days
after: The dressing is usually changed once a week and the line is flushed, at the clinic or by a nurse at home
Keep the dressing dry: cover your arm with plastic wrap in the shower
Do not lift heavy things with this arm or swim
Blood pressure and blood tests on this arm only as the clinic advises
red_flags: Swelling, pain or redness of the arm, neck or face
Fever or chills: call your doctor right away
The line slipped out, broke or is leaking
Sudden shortness of breath or chest pain: call your local emergency number

faq.q: Can I live a normal life with a PICC line?
faq.a: Yes, almost. Do not get the dressing wet, swim, or lift heavy things with that arm.
Usually not. The line is simply pulled out, and it takes a minute.

reminders.text: PICC line placement tomorrow. Wear a wide-sleeved top and bring your list of medicines.
